calls.title: Quick sync on AI market research
calls.summary: The meeting focused on launching a targeted customer AI research initiative aimed at improving product development through insights from selected key contacts, including established companies and AI-forward clients. Ashley will coordinate outreach with specific targets like Kelly at Khan Academy and Alex at Dropbox, while Jeremy expressed an interest in joining the calls for direct input. Discussion points will revolve around product development challenges and AI testing needs, with a developed questionnaire guiding the interviews. The team also emphasized the importance of competitive benchmarking to identify gaps in their AI capabilities, alongside a strategic commitment to prioritize enterprise clients and explore design partnerships for rapid feedback. The aim is to shift from reactive development based on customer requests to a more proactive, insight-driven approach.
calls.keywords: AI research, GrowthBook, MCP server, product development, customer interviews, competitive analysis
